scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.verify: npm run check:env && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.copy-ea:mac: cp scripts/mt5/ForexPro_MT5_Bridge.* "$HOME/Library/Application Support/net.metaquotes.wine.metatrader5/drive_c/Program Files/MetaTrader 5/MQL5/Experts/" && echo '✅ Đã sao chép EA vào MT5 Experts trên Mac!'
scripts.compile-ea:mac: cd "$HOME/Library/Application Support/net.metaquotes.wine.metatrader5/drive_c/Program Files/MetaTrader 5" && (WINEPREFIX="$HOME/Library/Application Support/net.metaquotes.wine.metatrader5" "/Applications/MetaTrader 5.app/Contents/SharedSupport/wine/bin/wine64" ./metaeditor64.exe /compile:"MQL5\\Experts\\ForexPro_MT5_Bridge.mq5" /log || true) && echo '✅ Đã biên dịch EA thành công!'
scripts.update-ea:mac: npm run copy-ea:mac && npm run compile-ea:mac
